translations.web: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”
translations.bsb: After three days, Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, since the king had said, “Come back to me on the third day.”
translations.kjv: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.
